title: Disappointin purchase. Buyer beware: parts missing, not worth price.
text: Disappointin purchase. Buyer beware: parts missing, not worth price.. Would not purchase again. Did not come with any instructions and was missing most of the screws it supposedly should have come with. I had to look up info online to confirm that I was missing pieces and get directions. (It did not have the picture info as stated by other reviewers). So considering we paid almost  $25 for a pole and had to supply our own screws, I am not impressed. Looking back, I wish I just ran to Home Depot.

product_metadata.title: John Sterling RP0020-48/72BRZ Adjustable Closet Rod, 48-Inch to 72-Inch, Painted Bronze
features: Painted bronze finish complements a variety of closet colors
Adjusts from 48 in. to 72 in. to fit your unique closet design
Holds up to 250 lb. for large closet loads
Heavy duty solid steel construction resists sagging and warping
Mounting hardware and built-in plastic wall attachments are included for convenient installation
description: This John Sterling heavy duty adjustable closet rod requires no detailed measuring or difficult cutting for installation, making this a quick and easy solution for your home closet. This durable steel rod adjusts from 48 in. to 72 in. to fit your unique closet size. Built-in plastic wall attachments and mounting hardware are included for convenient installation.
